=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:2209, 2878-2894 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The editor child’s credential scrub leaves credentials readable from the same-UID parent workflow shell, allowing an editor with network access to recover and exfiltrate them.
  WHY: Severity disagreement: deepseek rated this MAJOR, while minimax and openai rated it BLOCKER. Removing credentials only from the child environment does not prevent reading the parent shell’s `/proc/<pid>/environ`.
- scripts/run_plan_codex.sh:295-306 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The plan editor’s child-only credential scrub leaves credentials readable from the same-UID parent workflow shell.
  WHY: The editor has network access and can inspect an ancestor shell’s environment to recover and exfiltrate credentials.
- plan.yml:1253 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The plan workflow leaves `GH_TOKEN` in the parent workflow shell when it scrubs the editor child’s environment.
  WHY: The same-UID editor can inspect an ancestor shell’s environment and use or exfiltrate the recovered credential.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:78-92 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: Credential restoration verifies only that the modified remote uses `github.com`, not that it is the original repository, and scopes the restored credential to all `github.com` URLs.
  WHY: The editor can change `origin` to another GitHub repository, after which restoration and the later push at `.github/workflows/implement.yml:4698, 4712` can authorize operations against that unintended repository.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:504-510, 1316-1391 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Unresolved push refspecs can fall back to checking the current branch, and a merged-PR block on that branch returns before the requested confirmation is issued.
  WHY: The push is blocked rather than confirmed when the fallback branch has merged-PR history, even if the unresolved destination expands to a different branch; minimax also reported this issue in the workflow-templates twin.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:632-635 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The CI test invocation omits `tests/test_heal_evidence_editor_isolation.py`.
  WHY: The new contract tests for credential scrubbing, Git credential hiding/restoration, and scope-lock wiring are not executed in CI.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_evidence.py:1427 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: An empty `diag["exit_codes"]` list renders as `"Exit codes: "` with trailing whitespace and no value.
  WHY: Joining an empty list produces an empty string rather than an explicit `"unavailable"` or `"none"`.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:91 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: If restoration lacks `GH_TOKEN`, it leaves the marker file in place, causing subsequent `hide` calls to exit without hiding credentials.
  WHY: The restore path warns and exits, while the existing marker makes later hide attempts return early.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_evidence.py:105-110, 1442-1464 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The `scope-allowlist` subcommand can silently return an empty allowlist when its staged helper dependencies are missing.
  WHY: The `ImportError` handling masks the missing dependency, potentially activating the scope lock and blocking commits.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

  confidence=[2]

- requirement: "Pin this with a contract test (Auto-decisions AD-1) executed as part of automated CI verification." CI must run the introduced `tests/test_heal_evidence_editor_isolation.py` contract tests.

  confidence=[5]

  EVIDENCE: .github/workflows/ci.yml contains no diff hunk registering and executing the new suite, and `tests/test_heal_evidence_editor_isolation.py` is not listed in any CI step.

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- .github/workflows/implement.yml: Lines 2889-2891
  PROBLEM: The credential scrub removes GH_TOKEN/GH_PAT/TG_BOT_SECRET from the editor child process environment, but the parent workflow shell still carries these credentials and a same-UID child with network access can read the parent shell’s environment.
  WHY: An instruction embedded in untrusted heal evidence could direct the editor model to read `/proc/$PPID/environ` and exfiltrate the still-present parent-shell credentials. The auto-decision AD-1 explicitly chose option A (credential removal only, no full container isolation), and the implementation faithfully delivers that scope, so this is not a regression from the chosen plan.
  severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py: Lines 1385-1391 in _evaluate_bash
  PROBLEM: When a git push has both unresolved refspecs and resolved targets matching a merged PR, the unconditional block return fires before the bulk-reason confirmation request.
  WHY: A valid dynamic-refspec push on a branch whose head happens to sit on merged history is blocked instead of asking for confirmation, contradicting the documented behavior.
  severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
- .github/workflows/ci.yml: Line 635
  PROBLEM: `tests/test_heal_evidence_editor_isolation.py` is not registered in any CI job.
  WHY: The contract tests will never execute in CI, so regressions in the credential hide/restore flow or scope-lock wiring will go undetected until an heal-evidence implement run fails in production.
  severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_evidence.py: Line 1427
  PROBLEM: When `diag["exit_codes"]` is an empty list, the joined output is `"Exit codes: "` with trailing whitespace.
  WHY: The generator expression produces nothing for an empty list instead of an explicit unavailable value.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: AD-3 chose option B — "Implement, plus the plan stage (scripts/run_plan_codex.sh), which gets the same evidence block." The full scope states BOTH implement and plan editors get credential drops and structured diagnostics.
  Expected change site: plan.yml (the plan workflow) and scripts/run_plan_codex.sh
  Evidence of absence: The plan.yml PR diff (lines 283-289) only adds editor_git_credentials.sh to the staging script list. The plan.yml workflow itself has no credential env scrub step equivalent to what implement.yml received (no hide/restore steps in plan.yml YAML, no GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GH_PAT }} restore step). All credential scrubbing for the plan stage is in run_plan_codex.sh (a shell script, not the workflow YAML). The task and PR description name both stages explicitly; the plan stage's workflow YAML has no equivalent of the implement.yml hide/restore orchestration steps.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 2
